C0.title: Full backup (do this first)
C0.notes: OS 4.2.02. Byte-identical to backup_all.syx (dumps are deterministic). All 40 arrived within ~3 s of pressing retry: the port buffered the Dump All sent while the wizard sat at the retry prompt.

findings.text: header bytes 9-10 on a live 'All' dump: 22 02

C1.title: Baseline
C1.notes: Template 35 (User1) used instead of 36: slot 36 holds JV-1010 on this SL. vs slot 35 in C0: byte7 01->00; r00/r16/r17 +14 00->10 (factory value); r56/57/58 +21 7F/4E/5D->00.

C1b.title: Baseline, numbered dump
C1b.notes: Dumped slot 35 by number. Identical to C0 slot 35 except byte 7 (01->00). So numbered dump = stored template; Current (edit buffer) differs: E1/S1/S2 +14 = 10 (stored 00), pads K1-K3 +21 = 00 (stored 7F/4E/5D).

findings.text: numbered dump has the same header as 'Current'
